name: Kamal
description: Official CLI for building images, provisioning Docker hosts, and deploying applications over SSH.
details: Kamal coordinates Docker image builds, registry pushes, rolling deployments, accessories, and proxy health checks on servers you control.
best_for: You want the canonical Kamal tool and deployment workflow.
caveat: Kamal 1/MRSK tutorials describe Traefik and configuration that differ from current Kamal.

name: kamal-proxy
description: Reverse proxy powering health-checked traffic switching during modern Kamal deployments.
details: Kamal Proxy routes requests to application containers and participates in the cutover once a new release responds to health checks.
best_for: You need to understand routing, TLS, or zero-downtime rollout behavior.
caveat: This is an infrastructure component, not a standalone deployment dashboard.

name: Kamal documentation
description: Official reference for installing, configuring, operating, and upgrading Kamal.
details: Covers current commands, deploy.yml options, hooks, destinations, and version migrations directly from the project maintainers.
best_for: You are checking exact configuration syntax or the expected behavior of a command.
caveat: Choose the correct version of the docs; Kamal 1 guidance is separately maintained.
